Title: Associate Manager, APOC

Location: Bengaluru/Coimbatore

About App View X

App View X is trusted by Fortune 1000 organisations worldwide, including leading banks, healthcare providers, and enterprises to secure and manage digital identities. App View X is building the category for AI agent identity security. As enterprises deploy AI agents at scale, App View X gives security teams the visibility, governance, and control to do it safely. Our Agent Identity Security product discovers every agent in your environment, manages identities across their full lifecycle, enforces least-privilege access, and detects threats in real time.

Our Values

At App View X, our values reflect how we work together in practice—not just what we aspire to. They show up in everyday decisions, how we collaborate across teams, and how we treat each other while building and delivering our work. If these values resonate with you, you’ll likely feel at home here.

  • Clarity: We interact with transparency, simplicity, and shared purpose.
  • Unity: We build unity through mutual respect, trust, and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We stay curious, challenge assumptions, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Speed: We act with urgency, focus, and follow-through to deliver results fast.
  • Precision: We bring accuracy, consistency, and care to everything we do.

Role Overview

Associate Manager, APOC (Advanced Proof of Concept) leads the team responsible for building, running, and scaling advanced POC/POV environments that support App View X's global sales and solutions engineering organization. This role owns both the technical delivery of complex POC builds and the strategic translation of APOC output into measurable revenue impact - ensuring that custom work done for a customer compounds into reusable assets across the Presales engagement.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team & Delivery Management

  • Manage and mentor a team of Dev and QA engineers supporting advanced POC builds across global deal cycles
  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex, custom POC environments for enterprise and strategic prospects
  • Set priorities and manage workload allocation across concurrent POC/POV requests from the global SE team
  • Work cross-functionally with GS, Product, and Engineering to support workflow development needs, ensuring APOC builds stay aligned with engineering direction and platform capability

Strategic Revenue Translation

  • Go beyond POV-specific delivery: build a framework that connects APOC work to broader revenue impact — tracking reusability of workflow builds into the standing sandbox tenants and customer in POV tenants, rather than treating each engagement as disposable
  • Scope and support custom services engagements, identifying where custom workflows can be packaged into billable or extendable service offerings
  • Partner with SE Leads and Rev Ops to quantify and report how APOC output influences pipeline velocity and win rates

Enablement & Partner Training

  • Work with the Channel team to train partners on building custom workflows using App View X's extendable framework, enabling partners to independently deliver and support services.
  • Build self-enablement materials and trainings to certify partners on App View X automation.

Process, Digital Twin & Lab Management

  • Drive continuous process improvement to reduce time-to-delivery for POC builds, incorporating AI-driven methods and tooling into the build/test lifecycle
  • Own the Digital Twin bucket — recorded, repeatable sandbox setups and configurations that reduce rebuild time and standardize common requirement scenarios
  • Own lab management: environment optimization, resource allocation, and infrastructure improvements across the sandbox estate

Requirements

    • Strong background in PKI/CLM or adjacent enterprise security domains preferred (App View X platform experience a plus)
    • Demonstrated ability to translate technical delivery into business/revenue narratives, including scoping custom services engagements
    • Experience with process automation, AI-assisted tooling, or Dev Ops practices applied to lab/sandbox environments
    • Experience training or enabling partner/channel teams on technical workflows
    • Strong stakeholder management skills across Sales, SE, Product, Engineering, Rev Ops, and Channels

Why App View X?

App View X caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.

App View X is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is App View X’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.
